audit_metadata.audit_name: MBC Creator Journey Full Audit (Phase 1 -> Phase 6)
audit_metadata.rules: READ-ONLY, FINDINGS-ONLY, NO CODE EDITS, HEAD VERIFIED

findings.title: Complete absence of credit top-up or payment integration permanently halts user progression upon balance exhaustion
findings.what_is_actually_true_at_head: A full Creator journey costs 123-148 credits against a 200-credit grant. Depleted balances throw InsufficientCreditsException (HTTP 402). The codebase contains zero Stripe/payment gateway integrations and zero credit purchase endpoints.
findings.why_it_matters: Any creator who exhausts their starter grant is permanently hard-blocked from progressing through AI-gated steps without manual database intervention by an administrator.

findings.title: CreatorJourneyService.ReplaceAsync uses ReplaceOneAsync without optimistic concurrency
findings.what_is_actually_true_at_head: All updates to CreatorJourneys execute a full-document ReplaceOneAsync. Unlike CreatorIdeas, it lacks an ExpectedVersion check or targeted $set operators.
findings.why_it_matters: Concurrent operations, multi-tab browsing, or asynchronous background jobs will silently overwrite and destroy concurrent journey state.

findings.title: Hardcoded sample invoicing copy, brand traits, and colors render on Phase 2 Complete card when branding is skipped
findings.what_is_actually_true_at_head: If a user skips branding or has an incomplete brand kit, the completion screen renders hardcoded sample strings ('The invoicing tool that does the awkward follow-up for you', traits, and colors #2563EB, #0F172A) instead of an honest empty state.
findings.why_it_matters: Creators building unrelated startups see irrelevant invoicing copy and mock branding presented as their official project summary.

findings.title: Navigation CTAs drop ?ideaId= query parameters, causing fallback to first returned idea on refresh
findings.what_is_actually_true_at_head: Navigation pushes drop ?ideaId=. When refreshed, useIdea() queries GET /api/creator/ideas and defaults to ideas[0].
findings.why_it_matters: Users with multiple ideas risk silently generating Phase 3 or Phase 4 artifacts against the wrong startup project.

findings.title: Endpoint PATCH /masterplan/complete does not validate Market Study or Business Model, but ComputePhaseStatusAsync does
findings.what_is_actually_true_at_head: PATCH /masterplan/complete validates only 4 artifacts (forecast, plan, formation, legal). ComputePhaseStatusAsync requires market_study and business_model unless the legacy bypass is met.
findings.why_it_matters: A user can receive a 200 OK from /masterplan/complete while their Phase 3 status remains in_progress and Phase 4 remains locked.

findings.title: Legal Checklist, Formation Memo, Investor Scorecard, and GTM Strategy lack PDF or document renderers
findings.what_is_actually_true_at_head: QuestPDF renderers exist only for Market Study, Business Model, and Business Plan. The other 4 artifacts exist solely as browser DOM elements.
findings.why_it_matters: Creators cannot export legal compliance reports, formation memos, or investor scorecards for external stakeholders.

findings.title: Active idea payloads, brand drafts, and forecast slider inputs stored in localStorage without session expiration
findings.what_is_actually_true_at_head: Proprietary startup summaries, SVG logo code, and financial modeling assumptions are serialized to browser localStorage and persist across logout.
findings.why_it_matters: On shared computers, unpurged localStorage data risks cross-tenant exposure of startup intellectual property.

findings.title: Forecast initializes with synthetic $1M TAM, $49 ARPU, $8K OPEX, 12% growth, and 5% churn without synthetic disclaimer
findings.what_is_actually_true_at_head: If upstream Market Study is absent or sliders are untouched, synthetic constants populate the financial model without labeling.
findings.why_it_matters: Unverified synthetic defaults directly hydrate the 12-section Executive Business Plan and Investor Readiness Score.

findings.title: Training recommendations are absent; showcase landing page and roadmap are missing from Phase 4
findings.what_is_actually_true_at_head: Phase 4 implements Pricing, Resource Calculator, and GTM checklist. Training recommendations are absent codebase-wide. Roadmap is in Phase 3.
findings.why_it_matters: Significant feature drift exists between specifications and production code.

findings.title: Legacy logo tool route renders null and performs an immediate client-side redirect
findings.why_it_matters: Represents technical debt and redundant route entry.

findings.title: UI displays 'Issue Term Sheet' and 'Instant Capital Deposit Account' buttons without backing backend APIs
findings.what_is_actually_true_at_head: Clicking only triggers toast notifications or sets boolean flags in MongoDB.
findings.why_it_matters: Misleads users regarding the platform's automation capabilities.

findings.title: Phase 1 identity verification is a real vendor API integration with Sumsub
findings.what_is_actually_true_at_head: Sumsub integration is real, fails closed if credentials are unset, and verifies webhook signatures with HMAC-SHA256.
findings.why_it_matters: Resolves prior concerns that Phase 1 identity verification might be stubbed or bypassed.

findings.title: Step progression is dynamically derived from artifact state on every read rather than stored step counters
findings.what_is_actually_true_at_head: ComputePhaseStatusAsync overwrites returned phase and step status dynamically based on database document presence.
findings.why_it_matters: Resolves prior concerns regarding step counter desynchronization.

findings.title: Live Sumsub webhook transport delivery to public ingress endpoint
findings.what_is_actually_true_at_head: HMAC verification logic is confirmed at HEAD, but external network delivery cannot be exercised in read-only local audit.
findings.why_it_matters: Transport-level firewall, proxy, or header rewriting behavior in production environments remains unverified.

findings.title: Live INSEE French Enterprise Registry API connectivity
findings.what_is_actually_true_at_head: Code calls api.insee.fr, but live external API authentication and response handling cannot be exercised in read-only local audit.
findings.why_it_matters: Production API quota, latency, and credential validity remain unverified.
